title: Admission after a reset
text: A new Harbor gateway passes two admission probes, fails the next one, and then starts passing again. How many consecutive successes are now required, and what spacing must they have?

title: A warning that persists
text: A normal inlet queue has shown amber and has now drained to nine occupied slots. Does the warning clear at that point? Give the first occupancy at which it clears.

title: Two deployment policies
text: Compare the mapping-cache lifetime in the standard lecture deployment with the offline field-station deployment. Identify the scope of each number.

title: Supervised repair renewal
text: During a supervised repair, a lantern lease has already been renewed once. May it be renewed again, and how long was the permitted renewal?

title: Lost acknowledgment
text: An archive commit succeeds but its response never reaches the buoy. On retry, which identifiers should stay the same or change, and how should the archive avoid a second append within its replay interval?

title: Read after a receipt
text: A reader holds a receipt at position 120, but the query replica has applied only through 116. What does Harbor do before it can claim read-your-writes?

title: Late measurement disposition
text: A measurement belongs to the Harbor window starting at event-time second 40. The watermark is now 75 and the measurement has just arrived. Can it change the published aggregate, and where does it go?

title: Cost-model comparison
text: Under the teaching planner cost model, compare a plan needing nine random page reads with a scan needing twenty sequential page reads. Which is cheaper, and by how many cost units?

title: A narrow report token
text: An analyst has an ember token for revision 6 of one report. Before the token expires, can it be used to enumerate all reports or automatically read revision 7? Explain its scope.

title: Unverified checkpoint
text: A partition has three verified checkpoints and a fourth candidate that has not passed verification. Should the oldest verified checkpoint be deleted now?

title: North Quay recovery
text: At North Quay, a recovery drill encounters a checksum mismatch. Which checkpoint label and waiting interval does its station-specific procedure require before journal replay?

title: Read the routing sketch
text: In the recovery lecture routing sketch, which buffer receives the dashed amber arrow? If the available evidence does not show the figure, state that limitation.
